description: Defines an abstract generic class StreamSubscriptionHandle<T> that represents a subscription handle in Orleans streaming framework. It includes properties for stream identification, provider name, handle ID, and methods to unsubscribe, resume with observers, and check equality.

classes.name: StreamSubscriptionHandle<T>
classes.description: An abstract class representing a handle to a stream subscription in Orleans, supporting unsubscribe and resume operations with different observers.

methods.name: UnsubscribeAsync
methods.description: Unsubscribes the consumer from the stream.

methods.name: ResumeAsync(IAsyncObserver<T> observer, StreamSequenceToken token = null)
methods.description: Resumes consumption from a stream with the specified observer.

methods.name: ResumeAsync(IAsyncBatchObserver<T> observer, StreamSequenceToken token = null)
methods.description: Resumes batch consumption from a stream with the specified batch observer.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks equality between this handle and another for stream subscription handle.
